越南妇女学院（越南語：Học viện Phụ nữ Việt Nam）是位于越南首都河内市的一所全日制公办大学，该校由越南的全國性婦女組織越南婦女聯合會（越南语：Hội Liên hiệp Phụ nữ Việt Nam）举办及管理。

学校的历史可以追溯到1960年，当年越南民主共和国妇女联合会（越南语：Hội Liên hiệp Phụ nữ Việt Nam）决定成立中央妇运学校（越南語：Trường Phụ vận Trung ương），主要为北越培训各级妇联干部以及从事妇女运动工作的干部；1964年，北越妇女联合会决定学校更名为越南中央妇女干部学校（越南語：Trường Cán bộ Phụ nữ Trung ương）。2012年，越南政府总理阮晋勇决定学校更名为越南妇女学院，并由主要培训干部的成人高等學校转型为提供本科教育的大学[1]。
越南妇女学院是一所多科系的综合性大学，并面向越南全国招收女性学生。
专业领域涵盖了法学、经济学、管理学、社会学及工学等
学校也开设了婦女研究等一些具有代表性的专业

value.text:
Vietnam Women's Academy (Học viện Phụ nữ Việt Nam) is a public university in Hanoi, Vietnam. It provides full-time university education and is established and managed by the Vietnam Women's Union. Its address is reported as 68 Nguyễn Chí Thanh Road in the Láng Thượng area of Hanoi. The institution recruits women students from across Vietnam and offers undergraduate education in several fields.

The academy traces its origins to the Central Women's Movement School, established in 1960 to train Women's Union cadres and people working in the women's movement in North Vietnam. In 1964 that school was renamed the Central Women's Cadre School. A further change in 2012 brought the Vietnam Women's Academy name and a transition from an adult higher-education institution focused on cadre training to a university providing undergraduate programmes. Its teaching fields include law, economics, management, sociology and engineering, alongside women's studies. This history distinguishes the earlier training school from the academy's undergraduate university phase.
